description: Source code for the IsolationInfo class and related functions in the net namespace, handling security and privacy context information for network requests.

classes.name: IsolationInfo
classes.description: Represents security and privacy context information for network requests, including origins, site for cookies, request type, and related cryptographic tokens.

classes.name: NetworkAnonymizationKey
classes.description: Represents a key used for network anonymization, based on frame and site origins and optional nonce.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a site with scheme, used for cross-site checks and serialization.

methods.name: CreateForInternalRequest
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo for internal requests with a specified top frame origin.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (non-persistent) IsolationInfo with opaque origins.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an IsolationInfo object from a string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo with specified parameters.

methods.name: DoNotUseCreatePartialFromNak
methods.description: Creates a partial IsolationInfo from a NetworkAnonymizationKey, used internally.

methods.name: CreateIfConsistent
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo if the provided parameters are consistent.

methods.name: CreateForRedirect
methods.description: Creates a new IsolationInfo for a redirect to a new origin.

methods.name: frame_origin_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the frame origin for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsEqualForTesting
methods.description: Checks if two IsolationInfo objects are equal for testing.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo using an incorrectly used frame origin.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the IsolationInfo into a string.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the IsolationInfo.

methods.name: CreateNetworkAnonymizationKeyForIsolationInfo
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey based on the isolation info's origins and nonce.
